# Vent Busters

> Vent Busters is an insured air duct and dryer vent cleaning company based in Boynton Beach, FL. We remove lint and debris buildup that can restrict airflow and contribute to dryer fires, for homeowners along the Palm Beach County and Treasure Coast corridor.

## Company Facts
- Name: Vent Busters
- Services: Dryer vent cleaning and dryer vent airflow & safety checks (live now); air duct cleaning (coming soon)
- Based in: Boynton Beach, FL (2414 Venetian Way, Boynton Beach, FL 33426)
- Service area: Palm Beach County & the Treasure Coast, from Boca Raton to Port St. Lucie — Boca Raton, Delray Beach, Boynton Beach, Lake Worth Beach, Greenacres, Wellington, Royal Palm Beach, West Palm Beach, Palm Beach, Riviera Beach, Lake Park, North Palm Beach, Palm Beach Gardens, Juno Beach, Jupiter, Tequesta, Hobe Sound, Stuart, Palm City, Port St. Lucie
- Phone: (561) 448-4648
- Email: Ventbusters@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 7am–6pm, Saturday 8am–2pm
- Pricing: No fixed rate published — every home is quoted individually after a free, no-obligation on-site visit
- Credentials: Insured, trained technicians following a documented cleaning and safety process
- Guarantee: Satisfaction guarantee (see terms of service for details)

## Common Questions
- How much does dryer vent cleaning cost? Pricing depends on vent length, routing, and buildup — there's no published flat rate; a free on-site visit gives an exact, no-obligation quote.
- Is air duct cleaning available? Not yet — it's coming soon. Dryer vent cleaning and airflow & safety checks are live now.
- How often should a dryer vent be cleaned? At least once a year; every 6–9 months for heavy-use households.
- How long does service take? Dryer vent cleaning: 30–45 minutes.
- Warning signs of a clogged vent: slow-drying clothes, burning smell when drying, dusty vent covers, musty HVAC odor, rising energy bills.
- Same-day service? Yes, same-day and next-day appointments are available for urgent fire-risk situations, most often near Boynton Beach.
- Is duct cleaning a scam? The industry has a mixed reputation due to lowball bait-and-switch ads. Legitimate service includes a free upfront inspection, photo documentation, and no pressure to decide on the spot.
- What areas does Vent Busters serve? Palm Beach County and the Treasure Coast, from Boca Raton to Port St. Lucie — see the service areas page for the full, current list of 20 cities.
